newsitem.title: GERMANY: YMOS sells security unit to France's Valeo.
newsitem.headline: YMOS sells security unit to France's Valeo.

text.p: German industrial group YMOS AG said on Monday that it has sold its automobile security system unit to France's Valeo Group.
Terms of the deal, which will require approval from cartel authorities, were not disclosed. YMOS said a contract for the deal was signed on Saturday.
YMOS said the sale of the unit was part of its plan to concentrate its activities on building vehicle bodies and parts for the automobile industry.
The unit that was sold has about 1,450 workers and had 1995 sales of about 303 million marks ($198.7 million), which accounted for about 30 percent of Ymos' total sales.
The security system unit has operations in Heiligenhaus, Germany, as well as in France, Spain and Britain.
